adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, the `delete()` action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(() => { ... });` without any `.catch(...)`. If the DELETE request fails, the rejection is unhandled and there is no error feedback (unlike `save()`, which uses `.catch(popupAjaxError)`), so the failure can be silently swallowed from a UX perspective.
